description: Demonstrates the repetition/attempt tracking convention from Discussion #22 / issue #20 (raised by AgentVerity's maintainer): a ResultSet representing 3 repeated trials of the same test case, each carrying an ascending attempt (1-indexed, observation order) that pairs with test_case_id + run_id as the join key stability/flip-rate analysis needs. isolation is declared once at the ResultSet level (not per-Result -- see spec/SPEC.md Extension Mechanism -> Repetition & Attempt Tracking for why), meaning every attempt in this ResultSet shares the same fresh-session claim. A ResultSet like this MUST validate: attempt values are unique per (test_case_id, run_id, attempt), each is a positive integer, and isolation is a plain (non-enum) string.
